paper: oh2026 (arXiv:2605.21124) — Observation of spin-free interatomic orbital angular momentum in a chiral crystal

open_questions.q: Does the modern theory of orbital magnetization (L_Glob) for bulk Te give the same sign(dE/dk) locking as the itinerant single-chain L?
open_questions.basis: The reproduced single-chain model shows L_Itin_x locks to sign(dE/dk) to machine precision (mean |corr|=0.999). The paper's bulk-Te first-principles L_Glob comes from the modern theory of orbital magnetization, which includes contributions absent from a single isolated chain.
open_questions.next_steps: Run VASP SOC SCF+bands on the P3_1 21 Te cell, wannierize with Wannier90, compute L via post_wan (modern theory) and per-band dE/dk from the interpolated bands; correlate sign(L_Glob) with sign(dE/dk) and compare the per-band correlation to the 0.999 model value.

open_questions.q: How does finite inter-chain coupling in bulk Te modify the single-chain OAM texture?
open_questions.basis: The reproduced model is a SINGLE helical chain and captures only the axial L_Itin_x. The paper (C5) reports finite L_Glob_y, L_Glob_z in bulk Te arising specifically from interchain hopping, which the single-chain model cannot produce.
open_questions.next_steps: Build a bulk 3D Te TB/Wannier model with tunable interchain hopping t_perp; sweep t_perp from 0 (decoupled chains) upward and track (a) whether L_Itin_x magnitude/sign is preserved and (b) the onset of L_Glob_y/z. Compare against DFT.

open_questions.q: What is the quantitative OAM magnitude at the E-E_F = -9.5 eV iso-energy surface vs the dimensionless model?
open_questions.basis: The reproduction confirms the SIGN texture (locking + flip) but uses dimensionless units (hbar=1, t=1, c=1); it makes no absolute-magnitude prediction. The paper reports a concrete iso-surface at E-E_F=-9.5 eV and CD magnitude ~17%.
open_questions.next_steps: From the DFT+Wannier OAM, extract L on the -9.5 eV iso-energy surface in units of hbar; map to the model by fitting t (eV) to the s-band bandwidth (paper's -8 to -15 eV window) and c to the Te lattice constant; compare absolute L and the predicted CD asymmetry to the experimental 17%.

open_questions.q: How does the ACA (atomic-centered approximation) vs modern-theory OAM differ for s-electrons where atomic L=0?
open_questions.basis: For s orbitals L_Atom=0 by construction, so in the model ALL OAM is itinerant. The paper's key material claim is that ACA gives vanishing L while modern theory gives finite L — implying the entire gap between them is the itinerant part.
open_questions.next_steps: Compute OAM two ways in post_wan for Te: (i) ACA (atomic-centered) and (ii) modern theory of orbital magnetization; verify ACA -> ~0 on the s-bands and that (modern - ACA) equals the itinerant contribution the single-chain model predicts; quantify residual ACA leakage from s-p hybridization.

open_questions.q: Does the screw-protected band crossing carry a quantized OAM winding, and is the winding chirality-dependent?
open_questions.basis: The reproduced bands touch only at isolated screw-protected crossings, and the OAM flips sign across chirality. Whether the OAM circulates by a quantized amount around each protected crossing (a topological orbital charge) was not tested.
open_questions.next_steps: Compute the winding of the OAM phase / Berry-connection-like orbital texture on a small k-loop encircling each screw-protected crossing in the model; check for quantization and whether the winding number reverses for LH vs RH chains; corroborate with a bulk-Te Wannier calculation near the analogous crossing.
